reason: Worked example with complete verification: the round circle is compact complete and locally isometric to R hence locally CAT(0); R->S1_l is a covering with evenly covered intervals, so the generator loop lifts to a path ending at l and is not nullhomotopic, giving infinite cyclic pi_1; and the circle fails CAT(0) both directly (equilateral-triple altitude comparison) and because a CAT(0) space is contractible. Shows simple connectivity cannot be dropped from the globalization theorem. Re-recorded because its closure includes the edited globalization item. Level 13.
